introTitle: Comrade, Stop Sending Snowplows Out for a 1% Dusting of Snow!
introBody:
Do your Technical Services snowplows burn fuel clearing roads at 0.4% snow while your dense residential districts wait for garbage, sewage, and water trucks?

By decree of the [b]Supreme Soviet Municipal Services Directorate[/b], [b]TechServiceControl[/b] lets you tune all four Technical Services dispatch thresholds live in-game via the unified [b]F9[/b] overlay.
operatingSection:
[h1]Operating Tech Service Control (In-Game)[/h1][list]
[*] Press [b]F9[/b] anytime in-game to open [b]WRSR Tweaks [F9][/b] -> [b]Tech Services[/b] tab (or [b]Esc[/b] to close).
[*] [b]Enable Threshold Overrides:[/b] Master checkbox to toggle custom thresholds on or off.
[*] [b]Snowplow Dispatch >= %[/b] (1% - 90%, default 20%): Holds snowplows in the depot until road snow depth reaches this percentage.
[*] [b]Garbage Pickup >= %[/b] (10% - 95%, default 65%): Dispatches garbage trucks once waste containers or building bins reach this fill percentage (vanilla: 75% mixed / 60% fraction).
[*] [b]Sewage Pickup >= %[/b] (10% - 95%, default 70%): Dispatches sewage trucks once unpiped building sewage tanks reach this fill percentage (vanilla: 70%).
[*] [b]Water Delivery <= %[/b] (5% - 90%, default 40%): Dispatches water trucks once unpiped building water tanks drop below this fill percentage (vanilla: 30%).
[*] [b]Quick Presets:[/b] [i]Vanilla[/i], [i]Fuel Saver[/i], and [i]Dense City[/i] buttons apply recommended settings immediately.
[*] [b]Save Config (Ctrl+S):[/b] Writes settings to [i]TechServiceControl.ini[/i] beside the plugin DLL.
[/list]
examplesSection:
[h1]Recommended Settings by Play-Style[/h1][list]
[*] [b]Fuel Saver:[/b] Snow >= 35%, Garbage >= 85%, Sewage >= 85%, Water <= 20%. Minimizes fuel burn and truck trips.
[*] [b]Dense City:[/b] Snow >= 15%, Garbage >= 50%, Sewage >= 55%, Water <= 55%. Proactive servicing for high-density residential districts.
[*] [b]Vanilla:[/b] Click [i]Vanilla[/i] to disable overrides and restore unmodded thresholds.
[/list]
guaranteesSection:
[h1]Five-Year Plan Guarantees (Save-Safe & Lightweight)[/h1][list]
[*] [b]Graceful Standby:[/b] Each of the 4 hooks resolves dynamically via AOB signatures and falls back to STANDBY independently if unmatched.
[*] [b]100% Save-Safe:[/b] Settings live cleanly in [i]TechServiceControl.ini[/i] next to the DLL (binary WRSR saves are never modified).
[/list]
companionModsSection:
[h1]Companion Mods (Logistics Suite)[/h1][list]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3845998630][b]SmartDOBatching[/b][/url] - Prevent Distribution Offices from dispatching near-empty trucks or trains via [b]F9[/b].
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3845944617][b]CustomsSpeedControl[/b][/url] - Scale Customs House cargo Load & Unload speeds live via [b]F9[/b].
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3845533384][b]TradePriceLimits[/b][/url] - Set min-sell / max-buy price limits on Distribution Office border transfers ([b]F8[/b]).
[/list]
